lines.text: Mara said you'd seen the survey. That Colossus against the north wall came down three cycles ago, after a fight in low orbit. Her escorts are scattered across Asharu.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Mara said you'd seen the survey. That Colossus against the north wall came down three cycles ago, after a fight in low orbit. Her escorts are scattered across Asharu.

lines.text: And your people got to this one first?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: And your people got to this one first?

lines.text: First into the basin. We built the camp, cut a road in, spent a season just finding ways through her. The other outfits had their own wrecks to pick over. Then word got out about ours.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: First into the basin. We built the camp, cut a road in, spent a season just finding ways through her. The other outfits had their own wrecks to pick over. Then word got out about ours.

lines.text: You opened something worth talking about.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: You opened something worth talking about.

lines.text: Someone certainly thought so. They came in shooting while most of us were on shift. We pulled out who we could. Now they're stripping our yard and calling it an abandoned claim.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Someone certainly thought so. They came in shooting while most of us were on shift. We pulled out who we could. Now they're stripping our yard and calling it an abandoned claim.

lines.text: Anyone still inside?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: Anyone still inside?

lines.text: My cousin's crew, tucked away in the Colossus. They've kept a quiet channel open. The new owners are still picking through the stores. Haven't found all our ways in yet.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: My cousin's crew, tucked away in the Colossus. They've kept a quiet channel open. The new owners are still picking through the stores. Haven't found all our ways in yet.

lines.text: What was in the hold, Vale? I'd like to know what brought this down on you.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: What was in the hold, Vale? I'd like to know what brought this down on you.

lines.text: I told one person too many already. You're being paid to get us back to work. There's enough in that contract to leave the contents of my hold out of the conversation.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: I told one person too many already. You're being paid to get us back to work. There's enough in that contract to leave the contents of my hold out of the conversation.

lines.text: Your claim's on file with the local office?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: Your claim's on file with the local office?

lines.text: Permit and survey. You're welcome to those. I'd prefer to have the yard working before a Hegemony patrol takes an interest in the rest.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Permit and survey. You're welcome to those. I'd prefer to have the yard working before a Hegemony patrol takes an interest in the rest.

lines.text: Then let's be clear about the work. We're taking back the yard. Where do we stop?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: Then let's be clear about the work. We're taking back the yard. Where do we stop?

lines.text: At Morrow's cradle. She's our tender; her crew put her down when the attack hit. Get our technicians in to inspect her. If they can mend her, there's a separate fee for bringing up the repair rig and covering the work.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: At Morrow's cradle. She's our tender; her crew put her down when the attack hit. Get our technicians in to inspect her. If they can mend her, there's a separate fee for bringing up the repair rig and covering the work.

lines.text: Your parts and fitters. Our people keep them alive. We're not signing on to chase every scavenger on Asharu.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: Your parts and fitters. Our people keep them alive. We're not signing on to chase every scavenger on Asharu.

lines.text: Agreed. My militia have the road beyond the yard. The Colossus is for our handlers, and my cousin's crew will stay out of your way. Nobody's asking your marines to go digging through her.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Agreed. My militia have the road beyond the yard. The Colossus is for our handlers, and my cousin's crew will stay out of your way. Nobody's asking your marines to go digging through her.

lines.text: Receiving store first, then the workshop. My militia will follow you in. Cover our two technicians at Morrow's southern service access while they inspect her. Watch the south haul road; that's how the other crew has been getting in.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [businesslike, focused] Receiving store first, then the workshop. My militia will follow you in. Cover our two technicians at Morrow's southern service access while they inspect her. Watch the south haul road; that's how the other crew has been getting in.
lines.direction: Turn cleanly from bargaining to the job. Instructions stay intelligible.

lines.text: Contact at the south haul picket. There aren't many of ours out there, Captain. Give them a hand if you can.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Contact at the south haul picket. There aren't many of ours out there, Captain. Give them a hand if you can.

lines.text: South haul picket's coming in. Cover them back to the inner line.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: South haul picket's coming in. Cover them back to the inner line.

lines.text: We've lost the south haul post. Watch for anyone coming back, and keep that approach covered.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: We've lost the south haul post. Watch for anyone coming back, and keep that approach covered.

lines.text: The south haul survivors have reached the inner line. Help them hold it while the crew works.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: The south haul survivors have reached the inner line. Help them hold it while the crew works.

lines.text: Quarry road picket has contact. It's a small crew, Captain. Support them if you can.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Quarry road picket has contact. It's a small crew, Captain. Support them if you can.

lines.text: Quarry picket's falling back. Keep the crossing covered for them.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Quarry picket's falling back. Keep the crossing covered for them.

lines.text: The quarry post isn't holding anymore. Keep the inner line covered. There may still be people coming in.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: The quarry post isn't holding anymore. Keep the inner line covered. There may still be people coming in.

lines.text: The quarry survivors are in. They're holding on the inner line now; keep that ground covered.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: The quarry survivors are in. They're holding on the inner line now; keep that ground covered.

lines.text: The new gun's covering the inner line. Keep the crew working, Captain. We've bought them some room.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: The new gun's covering the inner line. Keep the crew working, Captain. We've bought them some room.

lines.text: That party on the south haul road has broken off at your screen. Keep watching the entry.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: That party on the south haul road has broken off at your screen. Keep watching the entry.

lines.text: They've broken off at your quarry-road screen. Don't leave the entry open.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: They've broken off at your quarry-road screen. Don't leave the entry open.

lines.text: Pump bend clear. Bring Morrow up behind the company and build a road gun. Keep her builders covered, Captain.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [firm, practical] Pump bend clear. Bring Morrow up behind the company and build a road gun. Keep her builders covered, Captain.

lines.text: There's a gun at the pump bend now. Keep that position covered while you move through the narrows. The haulers will need this road behind you.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: There's a gun at the pump bend now. Keep that position covered while you move through the narrows. The haulers will need this road behind you.

lines.text: Narrows secured. Build the next gun before moving on, Captain. We need the southern approach covered.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [firm, practical] Narrows secured. Build the next gun before moving on, Captain. We need the southern approach covered.

lines.text: The position's ready. Keep the narrows covered and clear the eastern yard for Morrow's drive test. Let's give her room to leave.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: The position's ready. Keep the narrows covered and clear the eastern yard for Morrow's drive test. Let's give her room to leave.

lines.text: She's in the eastern yard. The repaired drives are spooling. Stay with her, Captain; keep the approach clear.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: She's in the eastern yard. The repaired drives are spooling. Stay with her, Captain; keep the approach clear.

lines.text: Drive test complete. Morrow is climbing, Captain. Hold that approach until she's clear of the basin.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [relieved, focused] Drive test complete. Morrow is climbing, Captain. Hold that approach until she's clear of the basin.

lines.text: Morrow is clear of the basin. The registry transfer is authorized, Captain. You earned her. She's a working ship again.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [warm, quietly proud] Morrow is clear of the basin. The registry transfer is authorized, Captain. You earned her. She's a working ship again.

lines.text: Abort the departure. Pull back, Captain. I'll arrange to recover Morrow. The repairs and our agreement stand; we'll have to try the road again.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Abort the departure. Pull back, Captain. I'll arrange to recover Morrow. The repairs and our agreement stand; we'll have to try the road again.

lines.text: There's not enough company left to cover her. Break off the departure. I'll arrange hull recovery. Our agreement stands.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: There's not enough company left to cover her. Break off the departure. I'll arrange hull recovery. Our agreement stands.

lines.text: Morrow's out of builders. We can't finish the road positions with this wing. Break off; we'll recover her and fit another.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Morrow's out of builders. We can't finish the road positions with this wing. Break off; we'll recover her and fit another.

lines.text: Watch the south haul approach while the builders work at the bend, Captain.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Watch the south haul approach while the builders work at the bend, Captain.

lines.text: Keep someone watching the quarry road as you clear the narrows.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Keep someone watching the quarry road as you clear the narrows.

lines.text: Don't leave the pump road open behind you, Captain. We still need that position.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Don't leave the pump road open behind you, Captain. We still need that position.

lines.text: Hold the last approach. Morrow needs the eastern yard clear until she's away.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Hold the last approach. Morrow needs the eastern yard clear until she's away.

lines.text: The haulers are still waiting. Our people can't keep the outer road clear long enough to get them through.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: The haulers are still waiting. Our people can't keep the outer road clear long enough to get them through.

lines.text: That's beyond the yard. You said your militia had it.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: That's beyond the yard. You said your militia had it.

lines.text: I thought they could manage. I need your company to open it, with Morrow building positions they can hold after you leave.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: I thought they could manage. I need your company to open it, with Morrow building positions they can hold after you leave.

lines.text: We took the yard and covered your fitters. Both jobs are finished.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: We took the yard and covered your fitters. Both jobs are finished.

lines.text: I know. Send me a price for the road.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: I know. Send me a price for the road.

lines.text: A new contract, paid on handover. Construction and repair cover included. Anything you want moved out of the Colossus stays with your handlers.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: A new contract, paid on handover. Construction and repair cover included. Anything you want moved out of the Colossus stays with your handlers.

lines.text: I can settle it when the shipment goes. I've paid you, bought parts, kept this camp fed. The next money comes from getting those haulers out.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: I can settle it when the shipment goes. I've paid you, bought parts, kept this camp fed. The next money comes from getting those haulers out.

lines.text: So our pay waits on your buyer. We don't even know what you're selling.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: So our pay waits on your buyer. We don't even know what you're selling.

lines.text: You don't need to. I've paid everything I owe you.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: You don't need to. I've paid everything I owe you.

lines.text: You have. And I'd rather keep it that way. Pay us with Morrow.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: You have. And I'd rather keep it that way. Pay us with Morrow.

lines.text: No. We've just put her back together. Who do you think keeps the machinery working here?
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: No. We've just put her back together. Who do you think keeps the machinery working here?

lines.text: Her builders could leave you a defended road. We clear the positions, cover the construction and stay until your militia take over.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: Her builders could leave you a defended road. We clear the positions, cover the construction and stay until your militia take over.

lines.text: And I lose the tender I've spent all this getting back. Those repairs were my parts, Castle. My fitters.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: And I lose the tender I've spent all this getting back. Those repairs were my parts, Castle. My fitters.

lines.text: I'm not claiming we repaired her. I'm offering you another job for her. You've seen what our company can do.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: I'm not claiming we repaired her. I'm offering you another job for her. You've seen what our company can do.

lines.text: Use her for this. I'll let you keep her until the shipment clears, then pay you out.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Use her for this. I'll let you keep her until the shipment clears, then pay you out.

lines.text: That still leaves us waiting on it. We need something we can put to work, Vale. You've got a yard full of salvage. We've got a payroll.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: That still leaves us waiting on it. We need something we can put to work, Vale. You've got a yard full of salvage. We've got a payroll.

lines.text: The defenses stay here. You don't lift off while my militia are still trying to get into position.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: The defenses stay here. You don't lift off while my militia are still trying to get into position.

lines.text: They'll have cover while they move up. We hand the positions over before we leave.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: They'll have cover while they move up. We hand the positions over before we leave.

lines.text: And this buys you no part of the Colossus. Nothing in her, nothing that comes out of her.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: And this buys you no part of the Colossus. Nothing in her, nothing that comes out of her.

lines.text: Morrow, with title. That's the whole offer.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: Morrow, with title. That's the whole offer.

lines.text: When the road is handed over and she's clear of the basin. Her crew aren't part of a sale. I'll ask who wants to go; you find berths for anyone who does.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: When the road is handed over and she's clear of the basin. Her crew aren't part of a sale. I'll ask who wants to go; you find berths for anyone who does.

lines.text: Their choice, our payroll. Send the terms over for the Captain.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: Their choice, our payroll. Send the terms over for the Captain.

lines.text: All right. I'll send them. And Castle? Get her out in one piece. I've had enough of watching ships come down here.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: All right. I'll send them. And Castle? Get her out in one piece. I've had enough of watching ships come down here.

lines.text: She's holding a hover. Bring her along the road to the eastern yard. Clear the pump bend and use Build Vulcan Turret on ground her builders can reach, then prepare the narrows. Cover the work and wait for my militia to take over. Keep the company with her for the drive test. If the drives give out, break off; we'll recover her. The agreement stands.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: She's holding a hover. Bring her along the road to the eastern yard. Clear the pump bend and use Build Vulcan Turret on ground her builders can reach, then prepare the narrows. Cover the work and wait for my militia to take over. Keep the company with her for the drive test. If the drives give out, break off; we'll recover her. The agreement stands.

lines.text: Your company can't cover the work any longer. Break off. We'll pick up from whatever delivery and power work is finished.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Your company can't cover the work any longer. Break off. We'll pick up from whatever delivery and power work is finished.

lines.text: No builders left to finish the gun. Break off, Captain. We'll need another wing. The delivery and power work we've finished will keep.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: No builders left to finish the gun. Break off, Captain. We'll need another wing. The delivery and power work we've finished will keep.

lines.text: The distribution rig's waiting on the apron. Same terms we discussed: my parts, my fitters, your company covering them. We get it to the workshop, then bring the pump station back on line.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: The distribution rig's waiting on the apron. Same terms we discussed: my parts, my fitters, your company covering them. We get it to the workshop, then bring the pump station back on line.

lines.text: And the people inside the Colossus?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: And the people inside the Colossus?

lines.text: Still on the channel. I've told them to keep their heads down until the yard's working. I don't need another crew crossing open ground tonight.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Still on the channel. I've told them to keep their heads down until the yard's working. I don't need another crew crossing open ground tonight.

lines.text: The inspection mentions a construction wing. I thought Morrow's drones were for cutting ships apart.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: The inspection mentions a construction wing. I thought Morrow's drones were for cutting ships apart.

lines.text: They do both, with the right tooling. I've got a road-gun kit laid out. Connect shore power and we'll find out how many builders still answer. The yard lights should come back with it.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: They do both, with the right tooling. I've got a road-gun kit laid out. Connect shore power and we'll find out how many builders still answer. The yard lights should come back with it.

lines.text: A gun watching the approach would give our people room to breathe. Captain, we'll cover the builders while Vale's fitters work inside.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: A gun watching the approach would give our people room to breathe. Captain, we'll cover the builders while Vale's fitters work inside.

lines.text: Select Build Vulcan Turret and put it on clear ground within reach of Morrow's east bay. Keep fire off the drones. They're workshop equipment, not armor.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Select Build Vulcan Turret and put it on clear ground within reach of Morrow's east bay. Keep fire off the drones. They're workshop equipment, not armor.

lines.text: I've only small pickets on the south haul and quarry roads. If they have to come in, cover them back to the inner line. I'd rather lose ground out there than have nobody left to hold it later.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: I've only small pickets on the south haul and quarry roads. If they have to come in, cover them back to the inner line. I'd rather lose ground out there than have nobody left to hold it later.

lines.text: Captain, the company is already ashore in the secured yard. Escort the distribution rig to the workshop, then cover Vale's technicians at the pump. We're here to get Morrow working.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [composed, focused] Captain, the company is already ashore in the secured yard. Escort the distribution rig to the workshop, then cover Vale's technicians at the pump. We're here to get Morrow working.

lines.text: The rig's on the apron, Captain. Stay with it along the workshop road. Those parts took some finding.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: The rig's on the apron, Captain. Stay with it along the workshop road. Those parts took some finding.

lines.text: Rig delivered. Now get the pump station clear for my technicians. They need to reconnect shore power.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: Rig delivered. Now get the pump station clear for my technicians. They need to reconnect shore power.

lines.text: They're on the pump connection. Keep that ground covered until they've finished.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: They're on the pump connection. Keep that ground covered until they've finished.

lines.text: Shore power is on. Morrow's builders are answering. Select Build Vulcan Turret and place a road gun on clear ground within reach of her drone bay.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [pleased, practical] Shore power is on. Morrow's builders are answering. Select Build Vulcan Turret and place a road gun on clear ground within reach of her drone bay.

lines.text: Captain, our first road gun is built. That's Morrow doing useful work again. Keep the approaches clear while Vale's crew repairs her workshop.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [pleased, composed] Captain, our first road gun is built. That's Morrow doing useful work again. Keep the approaches clear while Vale's crew repairs her workshop.

lines.text: The workshop's running. That's the repair finished, Captain. Let the fitters close her up. I'll settle your fee.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: The workshop's running. That's the repair finished, Captain. Let the fitters close her up. I'll settle your fee.

lines.text: We've lost the repair crew. Pull back, Captain. We'll keep what work they finished. I'll have to find other hands.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: We've lost the repair crew. Pull back, Captain. We'll keep what work they finished. I'll have to find other hands.

lines.text: The rig's gone. We can't do this without that equipment. Pull the company back, Captain.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: The rig's gone. We can't do this without that equipment. Pull the company back, Captain.

lines.text: They're coming toward the yard. Keep them off the repair crew, Captain, and watch the builders. Those drones won't stand up to gunfire.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: They're coming toward the yard. Keep them off the repair crew, Captain, and watch the builders. Those drones won't stand up to gunfire.

lines.text: You're at the yard, Captain. Receiving store, then the workshop. My militia will follow and hold what you clear. Leave the Colossus to us.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: You're at the yard, Captain. Receiving store, then the workshop. My militia will follow and hold what you clear. Leave the Colossus to us.

lines.text: Receiving store secure. Workshop next, Captain. Watch the gaps between those salvage stacks.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: Receiving store secure. Workshop next, Captain. Watch the gaps between those salvage stacks.

lines.text: You've got the workshop. Morrow's service access is just beyond it, on her south side. Clear that ground and keep it covered for the inspection party.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: You've got the workshop. Morrow's service access is just beyond it, on her south side. Clear that ground and keep it covered for the inspection party.

lines.text: That's Morrow. She was ours before we opened that hold. Her crew put her down with half the controls dead when the shooting started. Let's find out what she needs.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: That's Morrow. She was ours before we opened that hold. Her crew put her down with half the controls dead when the shooting started. Let's find out what she needs.

lines.text: Captain, keep a watch on the south haul road. It's their way back in. Don't pull the inspection party's cover to chase them.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: Captain, keep a watch on the south haul road. It's their way back in. Don't pull the inspection party's cover to chase them.

lines.text: The service access is clear. My technicians are crossing now. Keep your people close enough to cover them while they work.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: The service access is clear. My technicians are crossing now. Keep your people close enough to cover them while they work.

lines.text: Hostiles at the service access. The technicians have stopped work. Clear them some room, Captain.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: Hostiles at the service access. The technicians have stopped work. Clear them some room, Captain.

lines.text: They've finished the inspection. It looks repairable. I'll release your fee; we can talk about getting the rig in when your people are ready.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: They've finished the inspection. It looks repairable. I'll release your fee; we can talk about getting the rig in when your people are ready.

lines.text: We've lost the inspection party, Captain. Pull back. We'll need another crew before we can do anything more here.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: We've lost the inspection party, Captain. Pull back. We'll need another crew before we can do anything more here.

lines.text: The raiders have our depot. Now they're hitting our freight checkpoint. Land on the rear unloading apron and reinforce the gate. More raiders are approaching along the freight and warehouse service roads. Wayline provides militia and one shuttle. Eliminate the bandit force, and bring as many people home as you can. Six thousand credits on success. Then we can deal with the depot.
lines.synthesisText: The raiders have our depot. Now they're hitting our freight checkpoint. Land on the rear unloading apron and reinforce the gate. More raiders are approaching along the freight and warehouse service roads. Wayline provides militia and one shuttle. Eliminate the bandit force, and bring as many people home as you can. Six thousand credits on success. Then we can deal with the depot.

lines.text: Talon Two is staying over the militia while they settle in. Push on when your people are ready.
lines.speaker: MARA VENN / WAYLINE
lines.synthesisText: [steady, conversational voice] Talon Two is staying over the militia while they settle in. Push on when your people are ready.

lines.text: Taking fire up here. Keep those emplacements off us.
lines.speaker: TALON TWO / WAYLINE AIR
lines.synthesisText: [strained, urgent voice] Taking fire up here. Keep those emplacements off us.

lines.text: Talon Two is down. Keep clear of the impact. The company will have to open the rest of the junction.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [concerned, firm command voice] Talon Two is down. Keep clear of the impact. The company will have to open the rest of the junction.

lines.text: Talon Two is heading home. Good work down there.
lines.speaker: TALON TWO / WAYLINE AIR
lines.synthesisText: [steady, focused voice] Talon Two is heading home. Good work down there.

lines.text: Talon Two again, Captain. Same crew, longer road. Coming up to cover the convoy.
lines.speaker: TALON TWO / WAYLINE AIR
lines.synthesisText: [confident, conversational voice] Talon Two again, Captain. Same crew, longer road. Coming up to cover the convoy.

lines.text: Talon Two, pass complete. Coming around over the column.
lines.speaker: TALON TWO / WAYLINE AIR
lines.synthesisText: [steady, focused voice] Talon Two, pass complete. Coming around over the column.

lines.text: We're hit! Still flying. Keep her moving!
lines.speaker: TALON TWO / WAYLINE AIR
lines.synthesisText: [strained, urgent voice, fast delivery] We're hit! Still flying. Keep her moving!

lines.text: Talon Two is down! Clear the impact area. Company, keep that convoy moving.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [startled, then firm command voice] Talon Two is down! Clear the impact area. Company, keep that convoy moving.

lines.text: Talon Two clear of the corridor. Bringing her home. The road is yours, Captain.
lines.speaker: TALON TWO / WAYLINE AIR
lines.synthesisText: [weary, relieved voice] Talon Two clear of the corridor. Bringing her home. The road is yours, Captain.

lines.text: Captain, Morrow is moving under her own power. Keep the company ahead of her and clear that pump bend.
lines.synthesisText: [pleased, focused] Captain, Morrow is moving under her own power. Keep the company ahead of her and clear that pump bend.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND

lines.text: My first militia team is in position at the pump bend, Captain. Bring your company forward when you're ready.
lines.synthesisText: [steady, reassuring] My first militia team is in position at the pump bend, Captain. Bring your company forward when you're ready.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION

lines.text: My second militia team is holding the narrows, Captain. Keep the company with Morrow for the climb-out.
lines.synthesisText: [steady, reassuring] My second militia team is holding the narrows, Captain. Keep the company with Morrow for the climb-out.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION

lines.text: Talon Two. Crossing the road, sweeping the ridge. Keep the column moving.
lines.speaker: TALON TWO / WAYLINE AIR
lines.synthesisText: [focused, brisk voice] Talon Two. Crossing the road, sweeping the ridge. Keep the column moving.

lines.text: Launch! Ridge launchers! Missiles inbound!
lines.speaker: TALON TWO / WAYLINE AIR
lines.synthesisText: [urgent, sharp voice, fast delivery] Launch! Ridge launchers! Missiles inbound!

lines.text: Rusk pays for the weir to work when we leave. Escort Edek's repair load, clear both sealed switching rooms, and cover the reconnection. Bring your working tender over the road position and build a Vulcan gun the constables can hold.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: Escort Edek's repair load from the service apron to the isolation switch. Keep the technicians covered.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: The repair cargo is delivered. Clear the northern switching room and stay with Edek's crew while they reconnect it.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: The north connection holds. Clear the southern switching room and cover the technicians there.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: Both switching rooms are reconnected. Call your tender with Ship on Station, bring it over the road position, and use Build Vulcan Turret. Protect the builders.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: The road gun is commissioned. Keep the position covered while the constables take the hold.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: North Weir is working and the road position is secure. Bring the company in for the handover report.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: The weir cannot be handed over. Withdraw and account for the company; Rusk will need a new mobilization.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: Recover the bonded archive, escort the supplier into the calibration cage, and cover the sealed load back to our western apron. The Recovered Specter pattern is payment for that recovery. Keep our people with the load.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: Our return point is the western apron. Clear the marked work area and keep the supplier covered. The checklist shows what still needs recovering.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: The archive is authenticated. Escort the supplier into the calibration cage and protect the work.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: The calibration kit is loaded. Bring its carrier back to the western apron with company infantry covering the route.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: The load is back with our people. The service files and calibration kit are accounted for.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: The recovery cannot be completed. Account for the company and withdraw; we will need a new mobilization.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: Secure Latchkey for inspection. Preserve the marked tooling, and hold dispatch, the hall and operator access together. Custody remains a separate agreement.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: Secure dispatch first. Our constables will occupy the gains. Keep the marked calibration machine intact.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: Dispatch is contested again. Restore that hold before the inspection can finish.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: Clear the tooling hall and protect its marked calibration machine.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: Secure the operator entrance so the inspection party can work.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: Hold all three sites. Keep company infantry and a living technician inside the tooling hall until inspection finishes.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: The tooling inspection is complete. Account for the company and read the custody proposals before any further commitment.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS

lines.text: We cannot complete this inspection. Withdraw and report the losses; replacement work needs a new mobilization.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY OPERATIONS
